description: This Kotlin source file defines the GatewayDiscovery class which handles local and wide-area discovery of gateways using Android's NSD (Network Service Discovery), DNS TXT records, and DNS over unicast queries. It manages discovery lifecycle, parses DNS responses, resolves service endpoints, and exposes observable flows for gateways and status.

classes.name: GatewayDiscovery
classes.description: Manages local and wide-area discovery of gateways via Android's Network Service Discovery and DNS-based mechanisms, providing flow-based access to gateway information and status.

methods.name: startLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates DNS Service Discovery for local gateways using NSD.

methods.name: stopLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Stops the ongoing local service discovery.

methods.name: startUnicastDiscovery
methods.description: Begins asynchronous unicast DNS queries to discover wide-area gateways.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a discovered network service to obtain detailed gateway info, parsing DNS TXT records and addressing.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Updates the gateway list and status text flows based on current discovery results.

methods.name: buildStatusText
methods.description: Constructs a status string reflecting current discovery state.

methods.name: stableId
methods.description: Generates a stable identifier for services based on service name and domain.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Standardizes service names by trimming and collapsing whitespace.

methods.name: txt
methods.description: Extracts a UTF-8 string value from DNS TXT record attributes.

methods.name: txtInt
methods.description: Parses an integer value from DNS TXT attributes.

methods.name: txtBool
methods.description: Interprets DNS TXT attributes as boolean values.

methods.name: refreshUnicast
methods.description: Performs DNS queries to discover and resolve wide-area gateway endpoints.

methods.name: decodeInstanceName
methods.description: Extracts instance name from fully qualified domain name, removing suffixes.

methods.name: lookupUnicastMessage
methods.description: Performs DNS query via DNSJava or local resolver to obtain DNS message for name and type.

methods.name: queryViaSystemDns
methods.description: Performs DNS query through the system DNS network interface.

methods.name: records
methods.description: Fetches answer records from a DNS message for a specific section.

methods.name: recordsByName
methods.description: Indexes DNS message records by name within a section.

methods.name: recordByName
methods.description: Finds a specific DNS record by name and type within a message.

methods.name: resolveHostFromMessage
methods.description: Resolves hostname from DNS A or AAAA records in a message.

methods.name: preferredDnsNetwork
methods.description: Selects the preferred network for DNS queries, prioritizing VPN.

methods.name: createDirectResolver
methods.description: Creates a DNS resolver using DNS servers from the current network context.

methods.name: rawQuery
methods.description: Performs a raw DNS query over a specified network using coroutine suspend.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Extracts a string value associated with a key from DNS TXT records.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from DNS TXT records for a key.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Interprets DNS TXT record values as boolean.

methods.name: decodeDnsTxtString
methods.description: Decodes a raw DNS TXT string, converting from ISO-8859-1 bytes to UTF-8 when possible.

methods.name: resolveHostUnicast
methods.description: Resolves hostname via DNS unicast A or AAAA records.

calls: delegate methods for DNS message parsing and network selection
